counterfactual.statement: 在预定短时域筛选中观察到 18 个候选行满足诊断阈值。

evidence_gaps: E10 training checkpoint has no implementation digest; current source is not the training-time proof.
Historical training logs do not record per-step bonus_tag.
A four-step residual screen does not prove long-horizon controllability.
The synthetic generation rate is not the actor visibility rate.
L0 has no tag input, so it is an interface control rather than a tag-sensitivity baseline.
policy_active_mask is identically one in ExperimentWorker.
The repository test suite reported failures. They are listed and were not deleted.
recommendation: 若继续做实验，应单独预先声明，并以本次未回答的问题为对照，而不是直接调大系数。短时域筛选看到了局部机会。这只说明这些冻结动作附近存在诊断意义上的差异，不能当作新策略已经更好。两处安全事件只有在重放匹配后才有证据标签；标签可以同时成立，不能收成单一原因。历史逐步 tag bonus 和训练当时的实现字节仍然缺失。
